// CHAOS-5156: closes a gap codex round r1 on #2292 found (independently
// confirmed against real lizard 1.23.0 before fixing) and exercises the
// new stateNameWithSpace/stateOperator/stateOperatorNext code this fix
// added -- a BARE (unqualified) `operator+()` does NOT reach this path in
// real lizard's Java reader either (JavaStates.try_new_function is a full
// override with no "operator" special-case of its own, verified from
// source), so that shape was intentionally left unchanged. A QUALIFIED
// operator (`Foo::operator+()`) DOES reach it, via stateNameWithSpace,
// which JavaStates does NOT override and therefore inherits from
// clikeStates unchanged (confirmed from source). Measured directly
// against real lizard 1.23.0: complexity 2 (base 1 + if).
class C {
    Foo::operator+() {
        if (x > 0) {
            x = x;
        }
    }
}
